decision.reason: [ev-af3b569bbd49] is a single changelog line saying that support for caching /series and /labels query results was added, and it points to PR 11539. It does not name the config key or flag that controls this cache, or say whether caching is on by default or must be turned on. It also does not say which deployments (for example, which components or cache backends) are affected, or what changes for an operator who does nothing. To write the subject, applicability and consequence aspects, we need the PR or the upgrade/config documentation.
